scripts.contract:check: bun run contract:types && git diff --exit-code -- packages/api/src/schema.d.ts
scripts.typecheck: bun run --cwd packages/api typecheck && bun run --cwd apps/portal typecheck && bun run --cwd apps/site typecheck
